title: Qubrid AI Fine-Tuning Entities
description: Schema definitions for Qubrid AI Fine-Tuning API entities including fine-tuning jobs, training datasets, hyperparameters, and fine-tuned model artifacts.

FineTuningJob.title: Fine-Tuning Job
FineTuningJob.description: A fine-tuning job that customizes a base model using a training dataset on GPU infrastructure.

id.description: The unique identifier of the fine-tuning job.

status.description: The current status of the fine-tuning job.

base_model.description: The identifier of the base model being fine-tuned.

dataset_id.description: The identifier of the training dataset used.

task_type.description: The task type for fine-tuning: qa for question answering, not_qa for general text generation.

fine_tuned_model.description: The identifier of the resulting fine-tuned model, available after successful completion.

created_at.description: The timestamp when the job was created.

completed_at.description: The timestamp when the job completed.

Hyperparameters.title: Hyperparameters
Hyperparameters.description: Configurable hyperparameters for a fine-tuning job controlling training behavior.

epochs.description: The number of full passes the model makes over the training dataset. More epochs let the model learn more but too many can cause overfitting.

max_steps.description: The maximum number of training iterations where each step equals one batch of data processed.

learning_rate.description: The learning rate for the optimizer controlling how much model weights are adjusted during each training step.

validation_split.description: The percentage of the dataset reserved for validation, expressed as a decimal between 0 and 1.

TrainingMetrics.title: Training Metrics
TrainingMetrics.description: Metrics captured during fine-tuning training including loss values and progress.

training_loss.description: The final training loss value after the last training step.

validation_loss.description: The final validation loss value if a validation split was configured.

steps_completed.description: The number of training steps completed.

epochs_completed.description: The number of training epochs completed.

Dataset.title: Training Dataset
Dataset.description: A CSV training dataset uploaded for use in fine-tuning jobs.

id.description: The unique identifier of the dataset.

name.description: The original filename of the uploaded dataset.

size_bytes.description: The size of the dataset file in bytes.

row_count.description: The number of rows in the CSV dataset.

columns.description: The column names found in the CSV dataset.

created_at.description: The timestamp when the dataset was uploaded.

FineTunedModel.title: Fine-Tuned Model
FineTunedModel.description: A fine-tuned model artifact produced by a completed fine-tuning job.

id.description: The unique identifier of the fine-tuned model.

base_model.description: The identifier of the base model that was fine-tuned.

job_id.description: The identifier of the fine-tuning job that produced this model.

status.description: The current availability status of the fine-tuned model.

created_at.description: The timestamp when the fine-tuned model was created.
